instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Implement the entire application in Bahasa Indonesia as requested by the user.
2. Use the primary color scheme: Dark Obsidian Neutral (#0B0B0E), Deep Maroon (#800E19 / #5E0B13), and Championship Gold (#EAB308 / #FACC15).
3. Build both the Public Portal (Hero, Profile, Categories, Schedule/Results, News, Gallery, Sponsors, WhatsApp Button) AND the Online Registration flow with dynamic validation and feedback.
4. Build the Admin Dashboard (/admin) allowing tournament officials to review, search, filter, approve/verify registrants, and see live statistics of categories and weight classes.
5. Ensure all interactive elements have explicit 'data-testid' attributes as defined in the testId requirements.
6. Provide full backend API support with FastAPI for registrant storage, status toggling, statistics endpoints, and email notification trigger mock.
7. Do not use plain Inter for headings: use Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or bold styled display typography with tracking-tight.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Maintain APCA-compliant contrast for all gold text against dark maroon and obsidian backgrounds. Never use low-contrast grey on grey.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_syndrome: Use asymmetric bento grids for stats, company profile pillars, and tournament gallery.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactive_feel: Add framer-motion micro-interactions for button hovers, card lift on hover, modal entries, and tab transitions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for registration confirmation, status change toasts in admin panel, and copy-link triggers.
